root_cause.text: The re-application of a global ASPM check in `amdgpu_pci_probe` that unconditionally sets the module parameter `amdgpu_aspm` to 0 based on a single device’s ASPM capability, which conflicts with the per-device ASPM handling introduced by commit 0ab5d711ec74, causing crashes on systems with multiple AMD GPUs where only one supports ASPM.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "This commit was erroneously applied again after commit 0ab5d711ec74 ... leading to very hard to debug crashes, when used with a system with two AMD GPUs of which only one supports ASPM." The patch removes the block `if (amdgpu_aspm == -1 && !pcie_aspm_enabled(pdev)) amdgpu_aspm = 0;` which was interfering with per-device evaluation.
